rationale_evidence.anchor: C1 ... Knower \neq Knowledge \neq Knowledge Space ... C6 ... Guṇa needs a scale before it may be opened
rationale_evidence.statement: Six negative constraints (C1-C6), assessed as the Gita's genuine kernel-relevant yield: C1 Knower != Knowledge != Knowledge Space (Ch5 sec15, Ch6 sec20) -- kills three identity mappings (Atma, Paramatma, Krishna) at once; C2 the kernel is a mind-like functional analogy, not an identity (Ch6) -- forbids 'the kernel is the mind'; C3 Moksha != infinite knowledge (Ch6) -- kills the completeness reading; C4 knowledge REVEALS rather than CREATES, so obscured != false != absent (Ch5 sec7) -- equated with MNAR, naming gaps A6/G-60; C5 action decomposes into act/subject/instrument/context/result (Ch5, H-290-1) -- orthogonal to, not a contribution to, the O blocker; C6 Guna needs a scale before it may be opened (Ch7) -- protects the theta gap. Concludes: the Gita's strongest contribution to the kernel is a set of refusals, not a set of objects.

rationale_evidence.anchor: The Gītā is rich in DISTINCTIONS and empty of CARRIERS. A kernel is made of carriers.
rationale_evidence.statement: Systematic explanation for why so little Gita material reaches the kernel: a kernel needs a membership rule, decision procedures, types/signatures, and carriers, whereas the Gita supplies narrative/normative guidance, directions of practice, roles (knower/guide/field/observer), and distinctions -- not carriers. This predicts the observed pattern: both T4 hits are separations (N notin K; W--Omega-->O), the six real contributions are refusals, and every attempt to promote a Gita term to an object (K_atma, K_supreme, Theta_total, Sigma=3 gunas) has been refuted on type-checking.

rationale_evidence.anchor: N1 ... N8 ... T3 — KnowledgeOS candidates, explicitly NOT kernel (8)
rationale_evidence.statement: Eight T3 (KnowledgeOS-but-not-kernel) candidates: N1 Karma!=Karma-phala -> Command!=Transformation (R6, Gita adds nothing); N2 Vairagya (non-attachment to results) -> Admissible has no outcome-dependent conjunct, invariant I-V, testable today (R6); N3 Sarathi (charioteer advises, Arjuna decides) -> Guidance!=Authority, AP-1, implemented 132/132 humanActRef (R6); N4 Buddhi (discriminative intelligence) -> the assessment stages, R4, but flagged: four stages not five since Knowledge is not a ratified primitive; N5 Yajna (offering/aggregation) -> evidence aggregation (025c,025n), correspondence unexamined; N6 Sraddha/Sanka (faith/doubt) -> trust/confidence/abstention rule, unexamined, collides with missing (Omega,F,P) if read quantitatively; N7 Kshama (forbearance) -> error tolerance, unexamined; N8 Dhyana (sustained attention/drift/reorientation) -> an epistemic-regulation loop, H-G6-1, blocked on delta<-T<-O. None is a kernel candidate; all sit above the kernel in assessment/evidence/governance/control layers.

rationale_evidence.anchor: ZERO gaps discharged. TWO sharpened, ONE shaped. That is the honest yield, and it is not nothing.

Explicitly did not edit/correct/supersede any external_research artifact (a registry act per artifact 19), did not propose O-Q1/O-Q2 as architecture, and confirms Steps 288-291 remain unchanged, all R6.
